Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp product inquiry, cardio equipment showcase, aur store location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://makfitness.arclanestudios.space

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Treadmill Shop In Patna team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Makfitness on Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp product inquiry, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated fitness equipment in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory, actual store photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
